channels.name: Direct operations
channels.text: We send our own team. Our people run the floor, on our phones.

channels.name: Delivery partners
channels.who: Shedi, the Mansoura partner, and franchise-style partners
channels.where: Hotels in four cities, Mansoura, and their own sites
channels.runs: The partner, to our standards, on our phones
channels.text: We partner with someone who hires their own team. They run the floor, and we take the final hours from them.

spine.text: Before anyone puts on a phone, we check who they are: a copy of their ID, a signed consent form, and the fraud briefing. The site suggests the person, we approve them.
Every worker gets their own account in their own name. Nobody shares one and nobody reuses one, so a flag always points to one person.
Our own team watches every video before the client sees it and decides: keep it, flag it, or delete it.

spine.step: Pay on accepted hours net of fraud flags
spine.text: We only get paid for hours the client accepts, and flagged hours come off first. Everyone in the chain is paid the same way.

shared: Whoever runs the floor, these four steps are ours. They are in every agreement, and nobody gets paid without them.

questions.q: Will the owner run the floor with their own people, on our phones?
Do we have a Portfolio Manager and anchors in that city?
Does the site have fiber, or a hub within reach?
Can a partner staff it and deliver hours to our standards?
